# DrawModePlusMLS

> Extra SceneView debug draw modes for Unity 2022.3+ / URP 14. Auto-injects a Renderer Feature. Agent skills ship in Skills~/.

This folder is a Unity editor plugin. When it lives under Assets/, Unity ignores `Skills~/`. Agents should start at AGENTS.md, then load the matching skill. Do not invent APIs from older README copies.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): router, hard rules, current contract
- [Host router](.mlsmoon/project-skill/draw-mode-plus-mls-skill/SKILL.md): pick a source skill; do not store host facts
- [Use the plugin](Skills~/drawmodeplus-use-plugin/SKILL.md): install, modes, texel density, troubleshooting
- [Develop the plugin](Skills~/drawmodeplus-develop-plugin/SKILL.md): architecture, adding a mode, verification
- [README.md](README.md): human overview and installation
